$description: Dark palette — Phase 1 (bg/text/border/brand.link/focus.ring) plus Phase 2's status color contract (status.*Subtle/on*/​*Border below). `brand.primary`/`primaryStrong`/`accent` and the solid `status.<name>` fills are still NOT overridden: they're used with white text on top (4.5-6.3:1 regardless of theme), so theme doesn't change their contrast. The Subtle/on/Border trio IS re-tuned per theme — see tokens/color.semantic.json for the shared rationale and the contrast numbers per pair.

heading.$description: Plain plum (light theme's heading color) is 1.41:1 on the dark page — fails even the 3:1 large-text floor. Re-tinted to 11.9:1 vs bg.page, 10.0:1 vs bg.surface.

caption.$description: Phase 4 STOP 2: this role had NO dark override at all — light theme's inkCaption got reused verbatim in dark (1.00:1 vs bg.page, 1.11:1 vs bg.surface). Re-tinted to 6.00:1 vs bg.page, 5.00:1 vs bg.surface.

link.$description: Plain rust (light theme's link color) is 3.35:1 on the dark page — fails AA text. Re-tinted to 5.11:1.

ring.$description: Plain magenta is 2.54:1 on the dark page — fails WCAG 2.4.11's 3:1 floor for a focus indicator. Re-tinted to 4.30:1.
